full_page.content:
1925, December
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOCK NO. 1.
Page 29 Cont.
6th-16th Telegram Rec'd from Seattle, Wash. Dec. 6th to Enroll Mrs. Ella Traynor in S.M.A. as against operation on Dec. 9th for cancer of the breast ..... To-day, letter from patient - same Mrs. Traynor reads thus: Seattle Wash. Dec 1- - 1925 ... "I was to have gone to Providence Hospit. at 4 o'clock Dec. 8 to prepare for an operation for cancer of the breast at 9 o'clock Dec. 9th. While receiving Holy Communion on the morning of the 7th the pain all left me and I felt well." Subsequent letters assure us of positive return of health without further treatment. Thanks be to Jesus in the Holy Mass.
27 Peter Anthony M (iller 4018 Phil'a W. ) Enrolled To-day 2nd time after hopelessly falling and taking pledge and falling again - feared to be losing his mind. - Business gone to nothing, wife fearing she will be forced to leave him. Please God we hope for a change before New Years.
28 Heart Failure Improving Francis Mac Kenzie 17 very weak of heart .. Board of health threatens to revoke his permit to work. is en- rolled and goes back to doctors - who now find him almost O.K.
31st Terrible Tumers etc Mrs. Cath. M. Lehr 56 of 2535 Drexel Ave. Suf- fering five Years from terrible tumers and high-blood-pressure is enrolled this evening for two yrs.
1926
1926, January
Jan. 9th Conversion after 55 years. Captain Cha's Jarrait Enrolled 2nd time perpetually in September last. Went to confession and Holy Communion for Christmas - first time in 55 years.
Febr. 4th Thomas Sutton 6 of 1544 Monterey (City) bronicale trouble after hooping cough enrolled latter part of Dec. Whereas before en- rollment the doctor bill was $104.00 a month -- has not coughed since he was enrolled.
Page 30
Febr .- 17th Blind Man's Case Man's Case Mysterious. Emil Dearvang A.C. 41 - 5714 Cadillac, having a Wife and 4 living children, began to lose his sight in June ( 12th) 1924. Every effort was made to check the growing darkness. Specialists after Specialists declare the case mysterious and yet hopeless. Was enrolled twice at least in the S.M.A. before going to the Ann Arbor Univ where he found no relief and no hope but to remain blind & go home. To-day he is again Enrolled in S.M.A. - in Hon of St. Anthony and St. Therese. We will hope
